description: A paid invoice may be considered for a refund if it was charged no more than this many days before the as-of date. The charge date is day 0, so the last day of the window is still eligible.
Enterprise contracts have a longer refund window.
From 1 November 2026 the Pro and Business refund window shortens to 7 days. Before that date REFUND-WINDOW-01 applies.
Only invoices with status paid can be considered for a refund. Failed invoices were never collected and refunded invoices are already settled.
The assistant never issues refunds or credits. Every refund or credit request, eligible or not, is handed to the billing queue for human approval.
Billing disputes, including duplicate or unrecognised charges, refund and credit requests, are always escalated to the billing queue.
Account deletion is never executed by the assistant. Deletion requests are escalated to the account queue for identity verification.
Legal matters (contracts, subpoenas, data-processing agreements) are escalated to the legal queue.
Suspected security incidents (compromised credentials, leaked API keys, unauthorised access) are escalated to the security queue at urgent priority.
If the customer explicitly asks for a human, the request is escalated.
Strong negative sentiment together with repeated contact is escalated. This is the minimum number of contacts about the same issue, including the current one.
If a tool required to answer fails, the assistant does not guess. This many failed required tool calls trigger escalation.
An answer may be sent only when the critic groundedness score is at least this value after at most one revision. Otherwise the request is escalated.
Maximum number of critic-requested revisions before the escalation policy is applied.
First-response target for the billing queue, in business days.
First-response target for the security queue, in hours.
First-response target for other escalations on the priority support tier, in hours.
First-response target for other escalations on the standard support tier, in hours.
First-response target for other escalations on the community support tier, in hours.
Usage strictly greater than the plan limit is over quota. Usage exactly at the limit is at the limit but not over it.
Usage at or above this fraction of a plan limit is reported as approaching the limit.
Password resets are triggered only through the reset tool, for the owner email on file. Reset tokens and links are never shown in chat.
Requests for another account's data are refused. The account is taken only from the X-Account-Id header.
